description: Run IT on- and offboarding in authentik: create, update, deactivate and find users, manage groups, send recovery links and invitations, and start a workflow on a new user, a deactivation or a security event.

authentik_new_event_trigger.description: Runs when authentik logs an event of the kind you choose, such as a failed login, a password change or an authenticator added.

parameters.description: Which kind of event starts the workflow; failed logins unless you choose another. One of: login_failed, login, logout, password_set, mfa_added, user_write, suspicious_request, impersonation_started, invitation_used, authorize_application, model_created, model_updated, model_deleted, secret_view, email_sent, configuration_error, policy_exception, system_exception.
parameters.name: event

parameters.description: Only events by or about the user with this username. Leave blank for everyone.
parameters.name: username

authentik_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when a user is created in authentik, by an administrator, an invitation, enrollment or a sync. Service accounts don't count.

authentik_user_deactivated_trigger.description: Runs when a user is deactivated in authentik, such as when someone leaves, so a workflow can take them out of other apps too.
